# Notice: vercel-react-best-practices (license declared, not verified)

Source: https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills, `skills/react-best-practices/rules/`, commit `1a2c79d4e6c4a2283dc2c614b6538cbe1ed5ca62`.

The upstream repository states "MIT" in its README and in the skill frontmatter (`license: MIT`). It contains no LICENSE file and no copyright-holder line, so the standard MIT copyright and permission notice could not be copied from upstream. This is an unresolved gap: the skill is gated behind `AI_SKILLS_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_LICENSES=true` and is pending legal review. If upstream adds a LICENSE file, store it here and change the manifest status to `verified`.
